description: YINMIK read-only status fixtures. Only pH (DP 10), conductivity (DP 11), and water temperature (DP 2) are supported measurements; other data points must not become measurements. Battery is null for this mains-powered meter.

cases.name: ha-calibration-note-2026-04-18
cases.source: jvallery/homeassistant packages/greenhouse/hydroponic_calibration.yaml: the raw values LocalTuya showed on 2026-04-18 (DP 11 2484, DP 10 621, DP 107 1400) against the YINMIK app's pH 6.22, TDS 1240 and EC 2480. HA's template corrections read them as pH 2484/400, TDS 621x2 and EC 1400x1.77.

cases.name: cutover-2026-11-15-probe-dry
cases.source: live read_status() from the ingestor pod with the sealed key, Tuya protocol 3.3 (3.4 refused, tuya_err=914), 2026-11-15T00:21Z. The probe was out of water, so the meter omitted DP 1 (TDS) and DP 11 (EC) and the pH is not meaningful; DP 7 reports 1 on this mains-powered meter.
